blocks.text:
Ready for a carefree day out? Slip your essentials into Case-Mate’s waterproof and washable Jelly Tote, perfect for defending them from splashes, spills, or daily messes.
Its stunning finish makes it a true statement piece for any occasion. The universal phone pouch inside accommodates any device size for on-the-go convenience. Worried about spills? The tip-proof design has you covered, so your belongings stay upright whether you're at brunch, running errands, traveling, or relaxing by the pool.
Carry this large, foldable Jelly Tote in style with luxurious Jacquard shoulder straps, and stay organized with the roomy interior complete with a key leash and attachment lanyard for effortless access. Once you’re done with your day, simply give your tote a quick wash, then fold it up for easy storage, ready for your next adventure!
Case-Mate Large Jelly Tote Features:Water-Resistant MaterialUniversal Phone Pouch for Any SizePremium Tip-Proof DesignLuxurious Jacquard Shoulder StrapSpacious Interior for Organization (17" X 8" X 12")Key Leash and Lanyard for Easy AccessIdeal for Everyday Use, Travel, or Beach & Pool DaysHassle-Free Vacation Essentials1-Year Warranty
Who are we: Since 2005, we’ve been setting the standard for stylish innovation, evolving from fashion-forward phone cases to a curated line of award-winning accessories, including our viral Jelly Tote Bags. The Jelly Tote Collection—featured in Oprah Daily, Good Housekeeping, Travel + Leisure, and more - offers a range of silhouettes, colors, and materials that are lightweight, packable, and washable, made to elevate every day and getaway. Our latest iPhone 17 Case Collection combines new elevated designs with enhanced protection, designed to keep your favorite accessory safe and stylish!

items.label: Chic Bow Design
items.value: This special-edition release is beautifully tied up with a chic statement bow, hand embellished with pearl beads that's as sweet as it is sophisticated; Its waterproof material helps repel splashes, sand, keeping the bag looking glamorous whether you’re heading to brunch, running errands, traveling, or enjoying time by the beach

items.label: Tip-Proof Design
items.value: Built with a wide, flat-bottom base, this jelly tote bag stays upright wherever you set it down, keeping your belongings secure and organized; Perfect for the office, car, airport, or poolside, the stable design prevents tipping and spilling

items.label: Touchscreen Phone Pouch
items.value: Our stunning jelly tote bag comes with a transparent phone pouch that fits all phone sizes, along with small essentials like chapstick, sunglasses, or keys; The touchscreen window lets you text, scroll, and check notifications without removing your device and protecting it from sand and splashes; it can be attach to the tote bag's included lanyard strap so that your phone or small essentials are always within reach

items.label: Luxurious Jacquard Handles
items.value: Carry your large jelly Tote bag comfortably, either by hand or over your shoulder, with luxurious, lightweight jacquard straps; Thick, soft, and sturdy, these straps will never dig into your shoulders, even if you overpack

items.label: Waterproof & Washable
items.value: Designed with waterproof materials, our jelly tote bag repels water effortlessly, so no need to worry about spills, sand, or dirt either; it's fully washable and easy to clean! Just wipe the tote off with a damp cloth for minor spills or toss it in the washing machine on a cold, delicate cycle; Air dry only after washing, do not tumble dry

items.label: Large Capacity Tote
items.value: Measuring 17"L x 8"W x 12"H, the spacious main compartment easily fits daily essentials like gym gear or travel items, as well as beach must-haves such as your latest beach read, towels, and snacks
